title: Low‑fat Milk, fluid, 1% milkfat, with added vitamins A and D

content.title: About
content.content: Low‑fat milk with 1 % milkfat is a liquid dairy product obtained by removing most of the fat from whole milk. Vitamins A and D have been added to enhance its nutritional value.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Low‑fat milk retains most nutrients of whole milk while providing fewer calories.
Vitamin A in milk is essential for vision and immune function.
Vitamin D helps calcium absorption and supports bone health.
1 % milkfat milk is popular in diet plans and among athletes.
In many countries, low‑fat milk is commonly sold in 1‑liter cartons.

items.title: Rich source of calcium
items.content: Calcium supports strong bones and teeth and plays a role in muscle contraction.

items.title: Low‑calorie protein source
items.content: Low‑fat milk provides about 3.3 g of protein per 100 ml, helping maintain muscle mass.

items.title: Vitamin A
items.content: Vitamin A promotes healthy vision, immune response, and skin integrity.

items.title: Vitamin D
items.content: Vitamin D aids calcium and phosphorus absorption, strengthening the skeletal system.

items.title: Low fat content
items.content: With only 1 % fat, the product fits well into calorie‑controlled diets.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: People who cannot digest lactose may experience bloating, gas, and diarrhea after consuming milk.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Allergy to casein or whey can cause skin rashes, swelling, or anaphylaxis.

items.title: Vitamin excess
items.content: Excessive intake of vitamins A and D may lead to hypervitaminosis, so adhere to recommended amounts.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Milk can be drunk plain, added to cereals, smoothies, baked goods, sauces, and protein shakes. It is also suitable for preparing infant formula and other baby foods.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store milk in the refrigerator at 1‑4 °C. Once opened, consume within 3–5 days. Do not freeze, as it can alter texture.
